response.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), group_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_remaining_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_storage / m.mean_remaining_storage AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_remaining_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.avg_remaining_storage / m.mean_remaining_storage IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, storage_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
